investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin outperforms Ethereum through Q3 2026 as altcoin capital flight accelerates amid ETF uncertainty and macro slowdown.

CNBC: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low
Trending: BTC ranked above all altcoins in crypto momentum
investment_theses.counter_view: Ethereum upgrade cycles (Shanghai, Dencun-style improvements) could reignite smart contract demand; ETH/BTC ratio may stabilize on institutional demand.

investment_theses.thesis: Stablecoin regulatory compliance costs will compress margins for custodians and issuers; Coinbase and Circle face rising enforcement burden through 2026.
